description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between search depth and evaluation metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Depth" and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5 with tick labels at each integer. The primary y-axis, on the left, is labeled "Recall@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.30 to 0.60, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 0.05. A secondary y-axis, on the right, is labeled "NDCG@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.15 to 0.22, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 0.01. 

The line representing "Recall@50 (Ours)" is green with circular markers and a solid line style. Starting at a value of 0.35 at x=1, it increases to approximately 0.48 at x=5. The line representing "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" is green with square markers and a dashed line style. It begins at 0.35 at x=1 and remains constant at approximately 0.47 between x=3 and x=5. The line representing "NDCG@50 (Ours)" is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. Starting at 0.16 at x=1, it increases to approximately 0.19 at x=5. Lastly, the line representing "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" is blue with square markers and a dashed line style and remains constant at approximately 0.16 between x=1 and x=5.
